name: Replit
description: AI-powered collaborative coding platform with Agent, Free Mode, and cloud deployment.
fullOverview: Replit is a collaborative coding platform with AI Agent for full-stack app development. Free tier with basic AI, Core ($20/mo) with $20 in credits and 30 hours chat/month, Pro ($100/mo) with Turbo mode and 15 collaborators.
cons: Pro is expensive
Credit-based system

name: Lovable
description: AI app builder that creates full-stack applications from natural language prompts.
fullOverview: Lovable is an AI app builder that creates full-stack applications from natural language. Features unlimited public projects on Free plan with 5 daily credits. Pro ($25/mo) and Business ($50/mo) plans unlock private projects, custom domains, and credit rollover.
cons: Credit-based system
Limited daily credits

name: Bolt (Bolt.new)
description: AI app builder with generous token-based free tier and full-stack deployment capabilities.
fullOverview: Bolt.new is an AI app builder with a generous free tier (300K daily tokens, 1M monthly). Pro ($25/mo) offers 10M+ tokens, custom domains, and no branding. Team plans available at $30/user/mo with hosting and deployment included.
cons: Token-based limits
Bolt branding on free

name: v0 by Vercel
description: Vercel's AI tool for generating production-ready React components and full-page layouts.
fullOverview: v0 by Vercel generates production-ready React components and full-page layouts from natural language or screenshots. Features $5 monthly credits on Free plan, Premium ($20/mo) with API access, Team ($30/user/mo), and Business ($100/user/mo).
cons: Expensive for teams
Credit-based system

name: a0.dev
description: AI-powered mobile app builder that creates native iOS and Android apps from text descriptions.
fullOverview: a0.dev is an AI-powered mobile app builder that generates native iOS and Android apps from text descriptions. Free tier for prototyping with limited builds, Pro plans from ~$20/mo for publishing and scaling. Built on React Native and Expo.
cons: Pricing not fully public
Limited free tier

name: Framer AI
description: Generative web design and layout platform turning text prompts into production-ready responsive sites.
fullOverview: Framer AI enables designers and developers to generate entire websites from a single text prompt. It produces fully responsive layouts, copywriting, and color schemes that can be further customized with Framer's visual canvas and published instantly to a global CDN.
cons: Requires learning Framer layout conventions
Advanced features require paid plan

name: Webflow AI
description: AI-assisted visual development platform generating semantic HTML/CSS structures, CMS items, and localized variations.
fullOverview: Webflow AI integrates generative capabilities directly into the Webflow Designer, allowing developers to generate layouts, write copy, populate CMS collections, and translate content across multiple locales with enterprise security.
pros: Industry standard for visual web dev
cons: Steeper learning curve for non-developers
Higher pricing tier for team workspaces

name: Wix Studio AI
description: Agency-grade web creation platform with AI responsive layout generation, text & image synthesis, and code assistants.
fullOverview: Wix Studio AI provides advanced web creators with intelligent tools including automated responsive section adjustments, AI-assisted code writing in Velo, smart image background removal, and prompt-driven layout scaffolding.
cons: Can feel overwhelming for simple sites
E-commerce transaction fees on entry tiers

name: Dora AI
description: Next-generation 3D web builder generating interactive 3D landing pages and spatial animations from natural language.
fullOverview: Dora AI allows creators to build immersive, animated 3D websites directly from natural language prompts. It transforms 2D web mockups into interactive 3D environments with scroll-driven parallax animations without requiring WebGL programming.
pros: Zero WebGL or Three.js code required
cons: Complex 3D scenes can increase mobile page load
Limited traditional CMS functionality

name: Relume AI
description: AI website architecture builder generating complete site maps, wireframes, and component-based layouts for Figma and Webflow.
fullOverview: Relume AI accelerates website discovery and wireframing by generating comprehensive sitemaps and wireframes from simple business descriptions. It exports wireframes directly into Figma or Webflow components using the industry-standard Client-First design system.
pros: Saves tens of hours on website planning
Widely loved by top web design studios
cons: Requires separate builder (Webflow/Figma) to finish sites
Free plan limited to single projects

name: 10Web AI
description: AI website builder and WordPress platform that recreates, hosts, and generates full WordPress sites with Google Cloud speed.
fullOverview: 10Web AI generates tailored WordPress websites with automated copy, high-resolution imagery, and Elementor-based drag-and-drop customization. It includes automated PageSpeed 90+ optimization, Google Cloud hosting, and AI URL-recreation.
keyFeatures: AI site recreation from existing URLs
pros: Brings AI ease to the WordPress ecosystem
cons: Tied to the WordPress ecosystem
Limited trial period before requiring paid tier

name: FlutterFlow AI
description: Low-code native iOS, Android, and web app builder with AI page generation, code assistant, and Firestore integration.
fullOverview: FlutterFlow AI accelerates mobile and web app creation by generating responsive screens, backend logic, Custom Dart code, and database schemas from natural language. It exports clean Flutter source code with zero vendor lock-in.
keyFeatures: AI screen and UI component generator
AI Dart code and custom action writer
Native iOS and Android app compiling
pros: Exportable clean Flutter code with no lock-in
Direct Apple App Store & Google Play publishing
cons: Requires understanding of mobile app architecture
Complex animations require custom Dart code

name: Base44
description: Conversational full-stack web application builder that provisions React frontends, database models, and cloud APIs.
fullOverview: Base44 allows developers and founders to build production web applications through conversational natural language. It generates React frontends, PostgreSQL databases, user authentication, and API integrations in a unified real-time sandbox.
keyFeatures: Built-in user auth and access control
Live code preview and terminal execution
pros: Generates both frontend and backend seamlessly
cons: Emerging platform with evolving ecosystem
Custom integrations require manual code tweaking

name: Marblism
description: AI platform that turns prompts into production-ready Next.js, Prisma, and Tailwind web applications with auth and payments.
fullOverview: Marblism generates boilerplate-free, fully functional full-stack web applications from product descriptions. It scaffolding includes Next.js App Router, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Stripe checkout, and Lucia/NextAuth authentication.
pros: Real modern tech stack (Next.js, Prisma, Tailwind)
Saves weeks of initial SaaS setup
cons: Best suited for developers who know Next.js
Credit consumption on heavy schema regenerations

name: Create.xyz
description: AI-first canvas for building websites, calculators, and internal tools with live preview and interactive components.
fullOverview: Create.xyz lets creators build interactive web components, calculators, forms, and functional mini-apps by simply describing what they need. It connects components to live integrations, databases, and third-party APIs with zero configuration.
pros: Embeddable in any existing website or Notion page
cons: Not designed for deeply nested complex architectures
Export options are simpler compared to raw Next.js repos

name: Softr AI
description: No-code portal and internal tools builder powered by Airtable and Google Sheets with AI prompt-to-app generator.
fullOverview: Softr AI turns Airtable bases and Google Sheets into client portals, member directories, and internal dashboards in seconds. Its AI app generator designs the database schema, sets up role-based access rules, and styles pre-built responsive blocks.
pros: Safest way to expose Airtable data to external clients
Instant permissions and user login flows
Extremely easy to maintain for non-technical teams
cons: Limited to spreadsheet/Airtable data structures
Advanced custom frontend logic is restricted

name: Glide AI
description: Enterprise no-code app builder with built-in AI column computations, OCR document scanning, and mobile app generation.
fullOverview: Glide AI enables business teams to create powerful mobile and web apps on top of existing databases like SQL, BigQuery, and Excel. Its native AI columns automatically categorize data, transcribe audio, extract text from receipts, and synthesize unstructured text.
keyFeatures: AI columns for automatic data processing
PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and Airtable integrations
pros: Exceptional mobile UX out of the box
AI data transformations run directly inside database tables
High security standards for enterprise data
cons: Rigid UI customization compared to raw React
Tier pricing scales with active monthly users

name: Uizard
description: AI-powered UI design tool that transforms hand-drawn sketches and text prompts into clickable wireframes and React mockups.
fullOverview: Uizard democratizes product design by allowing non-designers to create high-fidelity UI prototypes. Using its Autodesigner engine, users can upload paper sketches, take screenshots of existing apps, or write text prompts to generate interactive wireframes.
keyFeatures: Frontend CSS and React component export
pros: Turns whiteboard sketches into digital designs in seconds
cons: Exported code is primarily for layout reference
Less comprehensive vector editing than Figma

name: Locofy.ai
description: Design-to-code platform converting Figma and Adobe XD designs into pixel-perfect React, Next.js, Vue, and Flutter code.
fullOverview: Locofy.ai accelerates frontend engineering by converting static Figma designs into clean, production-ready frontend code. Its Large Design Model (LDM) understands visual hierarchies, tags interactive elements, configures responsiveness, and integrates state management.
keyFeatures: Figma to React, Next.js, and Flutter code
Clean Tailwind CSS and CSS Modules output
pros: Direct sync with existing GitHub repositories
Supports popular UI libraries like Chakra and MUI
cons: Requires clean, auto-layout structured Figma files
Complex business logic still requires manual coding

name: TeleportHQ
description: Visual UI builder and code generation platform converting OpenAI vision prompts and wireframes into clean React and Vue code.
fullOverview: TeleportHQ is a collaborative visual builder powered by an open-source code generation engine. It lets developers visually design complex web applications and export production-quality code in React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, and HTML/CSS.
keyFeatures: Vision AI screenshot to web page converter
pros: Broadest framework export support (React, Vue, Nuxt, HTML)
Clean separation of styling and component logic
cons: Smaller community compared to Webflow or Framer
Advanced dynamic backend connections require custom code
